note: Fight hints for Jev's combat plan choice (JEV_CONTEXT=v1). Only lessons with evidence from 2+ runs (notes/lessons.md, ds-handbook.md). Each text <= 25 words, conditional, literal. `when` fields must all hold: enemies (any enemy id present), fight (kind), act, hp_below_pct (player HP %), enemy_powers (any living enemy has one), no_attack (no enemy attacks this turn).

hints.text: Sandpit 0 kills me whatever my HP. Each Frantic Escape adds a turn: play a 1-cost Escape unless the boss dies first.
The Insatiable has too much HP to race: racing damage loses to the Sandpit countdown. Play Frantic Escape before extra damage.
While the Matriarch sleeps, HP damage wakes it and costs its free turns. Play powers and set-up cards instead of chipping it.
Sleep turns are free turns: spend all energy on powers or lasting block. On its last sleep turn (Asleep 1) attacking costs nothing extra.
Once awake, each Soul Siphon takes my Strength and Dexterity, so block cards get weaker every cycle: favour damage lines early.
Focus the Rocket first (runs won 9/12 vs 8/39 keeping both alive). The survivor's 99 Block lasts one turn: block that turn.
Rocket's charge-up is followed by a laser of {DMG:ROCKET:LASER_MOVE} ({BEHIND:ROCKET:LASER_MOVE} from behind): on the charge turn save HP and block, no HP-for-damage trades.
The two crabs share a big HP pool: permanent Strength and AoE lines are worth a few HP here.
Knowledge Demon curse turn (turns 1, 5, 9): it does not attack. Play powers now; they pay off over a 10+ turn fight.
Knowledge Demon gains {GAIN:KNOWLEDGE_DEMON:PONDER_MOVE:STRENGTH_POWER} Strength each cycle and heals 30 on Ponder. The fight lasts 10-15 turns: lasting_value lines beat small HP savings.
After Slap comes Knowledge Overwhelm, {DMG:KNOWLEDGE_DEMON:KNOWLEDGE_OVERWHELMING_MOVE} plus Strength a hit: keep block cards and HP for that turn.
Vantom's Dismember ({DMG:VANTOM:DISMEMBER_MOVE} plus Strength, plus Wounds) lands on turns 3 and 7. Save big one-shot block and defensive potions for those turns.
Phase 1: every Skill I play gives Test Subject +2 Strength. Prefer Attacks and powers; play as few Skills as possible.
Test Subject: three phases (A8 111/212/313 HP, lower ascensions 100/200/300); killing one does not end the fight. Enter phase 2 with 60+ HP.
Multi Claw gains one hit every turn: block it when the hand can, otherwise deal damage to end the phase sooner.
Each Beckon held at end of turn costs 6 HP that block cannot stop. Playing it costs 1 energy; on no-attack turns play them all.
Do not draw cards with no energy left: drawn Beckons cannot be played and cost 6 HP each.
Waterfall Giant explodes for its Steam Eruption stacks (+3 a turn) when killed. Kill it by turn 10, with HP plus block above the stacks.
Parafright is an illusion that returns at full HP each turn. Damage into it is wasted: attack The Obscura.
Dead segments reattach at 25 HP unless every segment dies the same turn: spread damage evenly, then finish them together.
Entomancer shuffles Dazed into my deck when attacked: kill it fast with few big single hits.
Mecha Knight hits {DMG:MECHA_KNIGHT:HEAVY_CLEAVE_MOVE} on its turn 4 attack: keep HP and block cards for that turn.
Extra HP traded for damage decided many lost boss fights. Burning Blood heals only after combat. Prefer lower hp_lost unless the line kills soon.
Do not lose 5+ extra HP just to apply Vulnerable unless big attacks will hit the Vulnerable enemy for the next two turns.
No enemy attacks this turn: a setup_turn line playing a power is usually best; lasting_value is worth a few HP now.
Drink defensive potions on turns with 25+ incoming or ending below 50% HP; not on turns with little or no incoming damage.
